long_biography.plain_text:
Reacquiring Islandaire after its parent company entered bankruptcy marked a decisive turn in Robert Hansen's career. Fedders had bought 80 percent of the HVAC manufacturer while retaining Hansen as president. In 2008, it sold the subsidiary's assets back to him, restoring Islandaire as an independent company under its original name.

Renewed control supported a deeper replacement-focused strategy. Islandaire partnered with Telkonet to combine packaged terminal air conditioners with wireless thermostats and energy-management technology. In 2018, he moved manufacturing to a larger Saint James facility, adding production and storage capacity. The sequence shows a founder using regained ownership to renew the product platform and expand operations.
